fact: The article reports that the Bank of Ghana and the National Bank of Rwanda signed a licence passporting memorandum in February 2025, which it presents among regulators' licence passporting initiatives.

The Bank of Ghana's press release states that it and the National Bank of Rwanda signed a memorandum of understanding on 25 February 2025 at the Inclusive Fintech Forum in Rwanda to introduce a licence passporting framework and cross-border payment interoperability for regulated fintechs licensed by either central bank.
